subject: Token-level attribution shim for LlamaIndex SDK — collaboration proposal
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@orbitlabs.ai>, Priya Nair <priya@llamaworks.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Token-level attribution shim for LlamaIndex SDK — collaboration proposal

Hi Ethan, Priya —

Thanks again for the demos last week. Orbit's streaming explanation traces are close to what many customers ask for, and LlamaWorks' LlamaIndex SDK is the obvious integration surface to make token-level attributions (provenance + model confidence per token) available to apps.

We'd like to propose a small joint effort: build a lightweight "token attribution shim" that sits in Redwood's runtime and exports a simple streaming hook the LlamaIndex SDK can subscribe to. The goal is to:

- make token provenance available in real time (token id, source doc cursor, span offsets)
- surface per-token generation confidence and logprob when available
- keep overhead <5% P99 latency for small (<=512) contexts

Attached is a one-page sketch of the API and a sample trace payload. High-level asks:
- Can Orbit provide the exact streaming event shape you emit today? (we can map fields)
- Can LlamaWorks add a subscribe hook in the connection layer so SDK users can opt-in?

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick tech sync (30m) to align fields and auth model.
2) Pilot: 2-week sandbox with a sample app (Redwood POV: runtime + shim; Orbit: trace adapter; LlamaWorks: SDK hook).
3) Short co-validated test: perf + a small prompt set to validate attributions.

Vanessa/Marissa/Jonas — looping you in for program support and to surface any go/no-go items (licensing, telemetry needs, or compliance).

Thanks,
Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
attachments: shim_api_sketch.pdf, sample_trace_payload.json

From: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@orbitlabs.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Priya Nair <priya@llamaworks.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Token-level attribution shim for LlamaIndex SDK — collaboration proposal

Thanks Mina — this sounds promising. A few quick notes from Orbit's side:

- Streaming event shape: we currently emit per-token events that include token_index, text, logprob, and source_doc_id. I'll attach a sample line protocol in the follow-up.
- Auth: token-based, short-lived (we can add a service account flow if Redwood prefers).
- Overhead: our instrumentation adds ~3% CPU overhead for typical traffic; network-wise the per-token websocket stream is tiny but needs batching at high throughput.

Questions:
1) Does Redwood expect the shim to transform fields (normalize doc ids) or just forward Orbit's native fields?
2) How will LlamaWorks surface opt-in? SDK flag or runtime configuration?

Tentative timeline: engineering sync next Tue/Wed; pilot in two sprints after alignment. We can commit an Orbit engineer (Nicolas) for the pilot.

Ethan
Ethan Wu
Engineering Lead, Orbit Labs
ethan.wu@orbitlabs.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@orbitlabs.ai>, Priya Nair <priya@llamaworks.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Token-level attribution shim for LlamaIndex SDK — collaboration proposal

Looks good — a few practical items from PM/ops side before we spin up infra: 

- Compliance: token provenance can contain PII depending on source docs. We'll need a checklist for data handling in pilot (redaction rules, retention TTL).
- Billing & credits: recommend a shared pilot credit plan — Redwood covers runtime infra; Orbit provides unlimited streaming during pilot; LlamaWorks provides engineering support in-kind.
- SLA/POC: define success criteria (accuracy of provenance mapping, <5% latency delta, no data leakage).

Can Marissa prepare a short partner pilot MOU? If yes I can route legal. Also, Jonas — please advise on the telemetry hooks required in Console for customers to see token-level traces (per-route toggle, token heatmap).

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

From: Priya Nair <priya@llamaworks.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@orbitlabs.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Token-level attribution shim for LlamaIndex SDK — collaboration proposal

Thanks — Priya here from LlamaWorks. We're excited to help make LlamaIndex a first-class integration with token provenance. A few implementation notes from the SDK perspective: 

- Hook location: best place is the Connection/Stream layer (we call it streaming_adapter). We can expose a callback: on_token({token_index, token_text, logprob, meta}) that consumers can register.
- Opt-in: SDK flag "enable_token_attribution": false by default; setting true will pull the subscribe hook and emit events to a configured endpoint.
- Backwards compatibility: If SDK consumers don't opt in, no perf or behavioral change.

Work items we foresee:
1) Define canonical field names (token_index vs idx, source_doc_id vs doc_cursor) — we prefer canonical forms to avoid mapping errors.
2) Decide on transport: websocket push to Redwood shim vs SDK POSTs. Websocket keeps lower latency.
3) Sample test corpus — we can provide a 100 prompt set to validate mapping.

We can allocate an SDK engineer (Rashmi) for the pilot. Happy to kick off the tech sync — Tue/Wed works for us too.

- Priya
Priya Nair
Product Lead, LlamaWorks (LlamaIndex)
priya@llamaworks.io

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Nair <priya@llamaworks.io>, Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@orbitlabs.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Token-level attribution shim for LlamaIndex SDK — collaboration proposal

Great alignment — thanks everyone. Short summary and next steps: 

- Field canonicalization: Redwood to propose canonical names in the shared spec (see Drive link). We'll map Orbit native fields to those names in the shim.
- Transport: favor websocket push from SDK to shim for latency reasons; Redwood runtime will accept websocket connections on a secure, short-lived key.
- Opt-in: LlamaWorks will add "enable_token_attribution" SDK flag default false.
- Compliance: Marissa to draft an MOU + pilot data handling checklist; Vanessa to route legal.
- Timeline: tech sync Wed 2027-01-27 10:00am PT (30m). Pilot window: 2027-02-07 -> 2027-02-21 (2 weeks).

Action owners:
- Mina: schedule sync, share drive spec and attach shim_api_sketch.pdf + sample_trace_payload.json (attached).
- Ethan/Orbit: share exact native streaming schema and assign engineer Nicolas.
- Priya/LlamaWorks: add SDK hook PR + assign Rashmi.
- Marissa/Redwood: draft pilot MOU and adjacency checklist.
- Jonas: scope Console UI telemetry hooks doc.

Can each owner reply with confirmation and any blockers by EOD tomorrow? If not, call me or Vanessa.

Thanks,
Mina
